title: Your PMS + NimbleRx: Connecting Pharmacy Operations and Patient Care
body_markdown:
Choosing new pharmacy technology can raise a practical question: Will it disrupt the workflows your team already relies on?


‍


With NimbleRx, the answer is no. NimbleRx integrates with your pharmacy management system (PMS) to fit into the workflow your team already uses while delivering a simple, easy-to-use patient experience. Patients get the convenience they have come to expect from online retail, including clear updates, digital checkout, and flexible ways to manage their prescriptions, while your PMS continues to support core pharmacy operations.


‍


## **What does a traditional pharmacy management system do?**


‍


A pharmacy management system is the operational system that helps keep prescriptions moving. Pharmacy teams use it to process prescriptions, manage dispensing workflows, maintain records, and track fulfillment activity.


‍


The PMS is built around the needs of the pharmacy team. It helps staff manage the work behind the counter and keep day-to-day operations organized. That role does not change when a pharmacy adds NimbleRx.


‍


## **What does NimbleRx do?**


‍


NimbleRx is a prescription fulfillment and patient engagement platform. It works through integrations with a pharmacy’s PMS and provides a better patient experience.


‍


Depending on the integration and the pharmacy’s configuration, NimbleRx can help support:


- Prescription-ready and status notifications


- Digital checkout and payment


- Applicable signature and approval steps


- Pickup and delivery coordination


- Refill management


- Secure two-way messaging


‍


Instead of asking staff to handle every update or routine request manually, NimbleRx gives patients a clearer way to take action from their phones. Patients can receive a notification, review relevant prescription information, complete eligible checkout steps, and understand what happens next.


‍


## **How do NimbleRx and a PMS work together?**


‍


The process begins in the pharmacy’s existing PMS. When a prescription reaches an appropriate status, like in production, verified, waiting bin, etc., NimbleRx can use that workflow information to trigger a patient-facing message.


‍


From there, the patient can review prescription details, pay digitally, complete applicable signatures or approvals, and select pickup or delivery when those options are available. Staff can then use the resulting order and payment information to prepare fulfillment, while prescription activity continues through the pharmacy’s existing operational workflow.


‍


NimbleRx can also help keep the relationship going after fulfillment. Refill reminders and HIPAA-compliant two-way messaging give patients a convenient way to request a refill or ask a question without always needing to call the pharmacy during business hours.


‍


The goal is to connect the steps around the PMS so the journey from “prescription received” to “prescription ready” feels easier for both patients and staff.


‍


## **Which PMS systems does NimbleRx integrate with?**


‍


NimbleRx integrates with many commonly used pharmacy management systems, including:


- PioneerRx


- BestRx


- Liberty


- Rx30


- PrimeRx


- DRX


- DigitalRx


‍


Available features can vary by integration, workflow, and pharmacy configuration.


‍


## **Why use both systems?**


‍


Using a PMS and NimbleRx together can help pharmacies improve the experience without disrupting the operational foundation their teams already know.


‍


For staff, connected notifications, checkout, refill requests, and messaging can reduce repetitive follow-up and interruptions. For patients, the experience can be clearer and more convenient. They can get updates when they need them, take care of routine steps on their own time, and choose how they receive their prescriptions when the pharmacy offers pickup or delivery.


‍


That convenience also supports the personal service independent pharmacies are known for. NimbleRx helps take routine administrative steps out of the way so pharmacy teams can spend more time on the interactions that require their expertise.


‍


## **What does this look like in practice?**


‍


[Bushard’s Pharmacy](https://www.nimblerx.com/articles/how-bushards-pharmacy-uses-nimblerx-to-modernize-the-patient-experience) uses Pioneer and added NimbleRx for messaging, online checkout, refill reminders, and a more self-service pickup experience. The pharmacy introduced the features in stages, beginning with messaging and chat before adding checkout and refill reminders. This approach helped the team expand the experience without overwhelming staff or patients.


‍


NimbleRx also helps Bushard's Pharmacy keep patients engaged between fills. More than 1,300 patients messaged for a refill in one month alone, highlighting strong demand for a convenient digital way to manage refills.


‍


A traditional PMS and NimbleRx are designed to serve different parts of the pharmacy experience. The PMS continues running core operations. NimbleRx works through integrations to connect those operations with patient communications, digital checkout, fulfillment, and refill engagement.


‍


The result is a more connected path from prescription processing to patient action, without requiring the pharmacy to replace the system at the center of its workflow.


‍
